verdict.rationale: Anrok calculates tax for new invoices and syncs transactions with the billing system, including via its Stripe integration (anrok-docs-33, anrok-docs-34). It also tells you which customer tax IDs to collect per jurisdiction (anrok-docs-10, anrok-docs-25) and handles registrations (anrok-docs-41, anrok-docs-18). Nothing in the evidence shows that invoice-level compliance elements, such as seller registration numbers, required VAT legends or reverse-charge text, or locale-specific formatting, reach the invoice or are generated by Anrok. Missing for 10: evidence that VAT-required invoice fields and seller registration numbers are pushed onto invoices, locale or e-invoicing rules handling, invoice generation, independent corroboration.
